skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will have a fundamental understanding of technology and its characteristics, and be able to apply this knowledge to explain, analyze, and evaluate scientific and technological activities at the organizational level.

Students will understand the dual nature of technology, the role of technology management, and the content of technology management at micro and macro levels, and be able to apply this knowledge to explain, analyze, and evaluate scientific and technological activities at micro and macro levels.
Students will be able to analyze, evaluate, and explain scientific and technological activities and technology management at micro and macro levels within a dynamic technological environment.
Students will understand the process of technological innovation, its effectiveness, and how to manage it.
Students will be able to analyze and assess technological capabilities at the organizational level using quantitative methods.
Students will understand the reasons for technology transfer, distinguish between endogenous and exogenous technology, and grasp the basics of technology reception operations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Government management of science and technology
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the models and organizational structures of government management of science and technology in Vietnam.
Students will develop skills to analyze and evaluate scientific and technological activities at micro and macro levels.
Students will be able to implement technology management activities in enterprises under a dynamic technological environment.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Using modern methods and tools for technology management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to use modern methods and tools for technology management at the organizational level.
Students will practice and improve their presentation skills.
Students will develop group management skills.
Students will develop the ability to independently carry out operational tasks related to technology management.
Students will develop the ability to continuously improve themselves, with a spirit of creativity and innovation, being adaptable to changes.
Students will develop a sense of professional ethics and social responsibility.
